    Yes, Rory McIlroy is still married to Erica Stoll. Although the golfer filed for divorce in May 2024, the couple reconciled and filed to dismiss the divorce petition just over a month later in June 2024, resolving their differences to remain together. The pair, who married in 2017, were recently seen together with their daughter during the 2026 Masters Tournament week. 
    Key Details: 
    • Marriage Date: April 22, 2017.
    • Child: They have one daughter, Poppy Kennedy, born in August 2020.
    • Status: The divorce filing was voluntarily dismissed in 2024, with McIlroy stating they are moving forward together as a family.
